title: Uncountably many local isomorphism types of compactly generated simple groups
summary: A major open question in the theory of locally compact groups is the following. Let $\mathscr{S}$ be the class of non-discrete compactly generated totally disconnected locally compact groups that are topologically simple. Is the number of local isomorphism classes of groups in $\mathscr{S}$ uncountable? We have answered this question, showing that there are $2^{\aleph_0}$ local isomorphism classes in $\mathscr{S}$.
